text: Hum TV HD is a 24-hour Urdu general entertainment television channel headquartered in Karachi, Pakistan, founded in 2005 by Sultana Siddiqui and Duraid Qureshi. It is owned by Hum Network Limited, which was previously known as Eye Television Network Limited until 21 January 2011 and is traded on the Pakistan Stock Exchange under the ticker (HUMNL). Hum TV began broadcasting on 17 January 2005 and held its first Hum Awards ceremony in March 2013. On 1 May 2018, the channel discontinued its SD feed and transitioned to HD resolution in Pakistan. It is one of Pakistan's largest entertainment networks, consistently ranking among the top and maintaining a dedicated fanbase across social media platforms in Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, and on streaming services as well as television. The drama series Humsafar, aired from 2011 to 2012, is the channel's most successful program to date, receiving widespread acclaim and international recognition, with critics referring to Pakistani television as a "Golden Age" due to its success. At the 1st Hum Awards ceremony, Hum TV was awarded the Hum Honorary Phenomenal Serial Award. The channel offers content across all entertainment genres, though its current dramas are primarily targeted at a teen and youth audience, with some series aimed at a more mature urban audience. Hum Network, a Pakistani media company, has increasingly relied on its YouTube presence for revenue; historically a traditional broadcaster, it has seen digital income—mainly from its official YouTube channel—grow significantly. The channel has over 51 million subscribers and 46 billion views, contributing substantially to digital revenue. Although the recent acquisition of Ten Sports has altered the overall revenue mix, YouTube's growth as a revenue stream remains a key trend, reflecting the company's successful adaptation to the digital environment. Network television serials are primarily produced by Momina Duraid Productions (MD Productions), owned by Momina Duraid, who is the wife of Duraid Qureshi and also serves as a senior producer at the channel. Other Hum TV shows are produced by Moomal Entertainment, owned by Moomal Shunaid, wife of Shunaid Siddiqui, the eldest son of Sultana Siddiqui. Moomal Entertainment was established in 2014.
